operations: Initialize every official FirstStartIni value only when launcher.ini is absent; append the previously verified serial and selected ISO just as Play writes them. The unchanged official GUI reads preferences and launches the game.
existing_preferences: An existing launcher.ini is preserved byte for byte; no missing defaults are backfilled.
media_import: SYSTEM.CNF, MODULES and supported ELF with the upstream PT_NULL conversion. Original ISO remains external and unchanged.
limits: Configuration and source parity only. No original-media extraction, game boot or gameplay in this proof.
